queries: WITH g AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_gb, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT g.*, AVG(avg_remaining_gb) OVER () AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT site_code, insurance_status, avg_remaining_gb, avg_cpu_gpu_gap, avg_remaining_gb / mean_avg AS storage_ratio FROM m WHERE mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

WITH g AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS zoneref, s.insurstat AS insurstat, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaininggb, AVG(p.proccpu - p.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing p JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaininggb) AS mean_avg FROM g) SELECT g.zoneref, g.insurstat, g.avg_remaininggb, g.avg_cpu_gpu_gap, g.avg_remaininggb / m.mean_avg AS storage_ratio FROM g CROSS JOIN m WHERE m.mean_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN g.avg_remaininggb IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, g.avg_remaininggb / m.mean_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The CPU–GPU usage gap is the signed difference proccpu - procgpu, averaged per group. Rows where either value is missing are skipped in that average.
The mean of all groups' averages is an unweighted mean of the per-group average remaining storage values. Groups whose average is missing are ignored in that mean.

Inner join to sites keeps only processing records with a matching site. Groups with a missing average remaining storage get a NULL ratio and sort last. A zero mean would cause a division error, which I did not guard against.

alternatives.interpretation: The gap is the absolute difference |proccpu - procgpu|.

assumptions.assumption: The CPU–GPU usage gap is the signed difference proccpu - procgpu, averaged per group. Rows where either value is null are skipped for that average.
The mean of all groups' average remaining storage is an unweighted mean of the per-group averages, not a mean over all rows. Groups whose average is null are excluded from it.
An inner join to sites keeps only processing records whose site exists. Each site has one insurance status, so grouping by site code and insurance status gives one group per site.

assumptions.assumption: The CPU–GPU usage gap is the signed difference proccpu - procgpu, averaged over rows where both values are present.

The inner join to sites keeps only processing records with a matching site. The mean of all groups' average remaining storage is taken over groups whose average is not null. If that mean is null, no rows are returned.
